title: fix(react): the console's own UI-state saves keep an open's API reads (one read per open)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GNMYnbm5cgRkMqUGpXobrR)_
Fixes #36497

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 控制台用户打开一个页面时,导航项和页面里绑定同一个接口地址的元素重新只请求一次;以前若打开过程中恰好保存了"最近访问"或"上次应用",页面会把同一地址再请求一遍。
- 为云端控制台的调用预算检查解决:它因这次重复请求时红时绿,云端不会抬预算或自行去重。
- 出错时最坏是用户自己的界面偏好保存后,同一次打开里的接口读数沿用先前的答案(该偏好不影响页面数据);撤回本改动即回到原行为。
- 无。

## What changes

- `ElementApiOpenScope` (`@object-ui/react`) no longer drops the open's kept API reads when the declared change is to `sys_user_preference`, the store the console writes its own UI state to as a page opens (`ui.recent` from `RecentItemsProvider`, `ui.app.last` from `LastAppProvider`, both through the data source, both reported on the bus by `useMutationInvalidationBridge`). Every other declared change, `'*'` included, still ends the reuse exactly as before. The object set is one module-private constant, `UI_STATE_OBJECTS`, documented beside the scope rule it refines; no export, no new prop.
- The bus and the bridge are untouched: the preference save is still reported, so the readers that name `sys_user_preference` still refresh.

### Route chosen, and why not the other one

The card proposed two routes; the dispatch asked to measure who else listens to `sys_user_preference` changes before choosing, and to prefer the route that keeps an object list out of the generic read cache when both work.

- **(b) the preference save stops announcing on the bus** does not work: the card's premise "no page displays that data" is false on `origin/main` `06c3e5ac59`. The User record page (`pages/sys-user.page.ts` in `@objectstack/platform-objects`, the "Preferences" tab) mounts a `record:related_list` of `sys_user_preference` sorted by `updated_at` desc, with `showViewAll` into the object's own list views (`all_preferences`, `my_preferences`, `by_user`); `RelatedList` refetches on the bus (and on the legacy related-changed window event the bus dispatches), and `RelatedCountStore.invalidate(objectName)` refreshes its tab badge. Opening one's own user record writes `ui.recent`, so (b) would leave that list a row behind on the page where an administrator reads those rows. It would also break the bridge's own stated contract ("every create/update/delete performed through the dataSource reaches all `useDataInvalidation` readers"). Implementing (b) at the adapter instead is not possible without a new channel on `DataSourceMutationEvent` (`@object-ui/types`), outside this card's surface.
- **(a) the open scope lets UI-state changes go by** works and touches nothing a reader of `sys_user_preference` sees. Every other bus subscriber in `ui/` was read: all of them filter by object through `dataChangeMatches` (related counts, field access, queue claim, reference rail, master-detail, record detail children, connected access, hover card, every `useDataInvalidation` reader); `ElementApiOpenScope` is the ONLY unfiltered subscriber. So the exception lives in the one place that judges "any change", and nowhere else.
- The cost of (a), stated plainly: a host-agnostic package now names one platform object. A host that points the preference adapter at another `resource` would not be covered; none in this tree does. A host-declared prop on the scope would avoid naming it, but the console's mount (`ConsoleElementApiOpen`) is outside this card's claimed file surface; noted below as an option, not taken.
- No timeout and no request de-duplication were added.

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/elementApiOpenScope.uiStateWrites-36497.test.tsx`, over the real `useMutationInvalidationBridge`, the real `ElementApiOpenScope`, a navigation reader that reads like the nav gate (`readElementApi` with the open it is in) and the real `SchemaRenderer` for the page element, mounted only after the navigation read has settled:

- the regression pin: a preference save (an update of the `ui.recent` row, and a create of a new `ui.app.last` row) between the nav read and the page mount asks the URL once;
- the save still reaches `useDataInvalidation('sys_user_preference')` (the reason (b) was not taken);
- CONTROL: a save to `account` in the same window ends the reuse, and the element asks again.

<details><summary>Readings (head 8c67f459a2, under scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh)</summary>

- New file, red before the fix is applied (ablation below), green with it.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/react/src/element-data-source/ packages/react/src/data-invalidation.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/navEntryReadReuse-13323.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.apiElementReread-31891.test.tsx`: `Test Files 13 passed (13)` · `Tests 151 passed (151)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This includes the existing one-read-per-open pins (objectui#13323), its case "(d) a declared data change ends the reuse", and the re-read pins (31891).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`; the new test file is in the test program (`--listFiles` count 1).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the fix removed, the pin goes red</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (literal anchor must hit once, blob must change, restore proven). Anchor `if (!UI_STATE_OBJECTS.has(change.objectName)) reads.clear();` replaced by an unconditional `reads.clear()`: anchor x1 to x0, blob `2140c40ac9c6` to `4172de684b6a`. Run of the new file: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`, both regression cases failing with `the page element asked the URL the navigation already read: expected 2 to be 1`; the bus-reader case and the CONTROL stayed green. Restore: blob after `2140c40ac9c6` equals HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `src` relatively, so no `dist/` leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ObjectStackAdapter.dropInflightReads` also clears the in-flight and prefetched record-page payloads on a write to ANY resource, a preference save included, by the same "a payload carries other objects' rows" reasoning this card corrects for the open scope. Not measured as a double read; not touched here.
- Option not taken: an `ElementApiOpenScope` prop through which the host names its own UI-state objects, passed by `ConsoleElementApiOpen`. It would keep the object name out of `@object-ui/react`, at the cost of a second file outside this card's surface.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/elementApiOpenScope.uiStateWrites-36497.test.tsx` — 4 passing tests expected.

Files to read first: `ui/packages/react/src/element-data-source/useElementApiDataSource.ts` (`UI_STATE_OBJECTS` and the `ElementApiOpenScope` subscription), then the new test file.
